response.sql: WITH project_rates AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS size_per_minute FROM scans AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(size_per_minute) AS avg_project_rate FROM project_rates) SELECT pr.arcref, pr.fundflux, pr.size_per_minute AS rate, pr.size_per_minute - b.avg_project_rate AS gap_above_benchmark FROM project_rates AS pr CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE pr.size_per_minute > b.avg_project_rate ORDER BY gap_above_benchmark DESC LIMIT 10;
